Review Text:
Phone – Fold 3

The protector costs $75.90 for a phablet.

Bought and applied on 28 July 2022 (Thursday). Entire process is around an hour. Due to the application issues, there was a scratch on the screen protector. Resend on 29 July 2022 (Friday) for re-application. The entire process took over an hour.

During the second application, the staff handed back the phone to me for check, for which I assumed that the job was completed. After seeing some poor finishing, he than mentioned he was just showing me the phone to check. I was like “check what” if it was not completed. Why don’t you complete the job before letting me check the finishing?

After the second completion, still not satisfied with the application, I asked him if this was how the product is supposed to look after it is completed. He mentioned yes. After debating for a few rounds, he told me to go and write a Google review if I am still not satisfied. I was like wow, great way to speak to your customers. I said thank you and left. For clarity, I left because the staff told me that the application of the screen protector is as good as it gets so.

For your information, pictures were taken on 30 July 2022 (1 day after application). I let the pictures do the talking, cause for the price, expected the finishing to be much better. If this was $10 or $20, I can close one eye. But $75.90 for a screen protector is pricey and IMO, I expected a lot more.

Also, these pictures were taken one day after, so you can imagine how well the protectors hold.

I do see their staff genuinely trying to help, doing their best to rectify the issues, could have been a tad bit more apologetic though. But fundamentally speaking, I think that there is a product flaw as the protector does not apply smoothly across all the surfaces. This could be due to the phone curves edge but in this case, don’t sell for this model. If you are going to charge $75.90, the customer is going to expect more for the product.

The $10 lifetime warranty is not useful too. If the product is fundamentally flawed, no point giving lifetime warranty as it does not solve the product issue in the first place.

Your phone is also going to be very hot after application as they use a heat dryer for application.

Overall, not too great an experience, but guess this is as good as it is going to get. Almost 3 hours and $75.90 loss, let my loss be your gain. Customer service also does not make up for the entire experience. Skip the product, just go somewhere else.

2 out of 5 starts and do not recommend.

Above represents my own opinion only.

Review Text:
Ideas by Gul Ahmed, located on Jarranwala Road in Faisalabad, is a well-known clothing brand that unfortunately failed to impress me during my recent visit. While the brand's commitment to quality fabrics and craftsmanship is evident, the limited variety and lack of new designs left me underwhelmed. The classic, elegant designs that Ideas is renowned for were plentiful, but the overall collection felt stale and outdated.
As I browsed through the racks, I couldn't help but notice the repetitive designs that seemed to dominate the store. The absence of modern and trendy clothing options was striking, making it clear that Ideas is currently catering to a very specific demographic. Those seeking timeless, classic attire will undoubtedly find something to their liking; however, fashion enthusiasts and individuals seeking stylish, contemporary clothing may find themselves disappointed.
To regain its footing in the competitive clothing market, Ideas by Gul Ahmed needs to refresh its collection and incorporate more diverse and modern designs. This could be achieved by expanding their design team to bring in fresh perspectives, introducing seasonal collections with modern twists, and catering to a broader range of customer preferences. Until then, loyal customers may find themselves seeking alternative brands for stylish and contemporary clothing.
Overall, Ideas by Gul Ahmed remains a reliable choice for classic attire, but its failure to innovate and adapt to changing fashion trends holds it back from reaching its full potential. With some revitalization, this esteemed brand can once again become a go to destination for fashion conscious consumers.

Review Text:
Very disappointed that this store does not stand by the quality of their products, especially when they are found to be defective and stitched improperly. I was visiting from America during December of 2023 and came her to shop for clothes for myself and my daughters.  No doubt, the shirt pieces here are beautiful, but buyer beware, they are not meant to hold up to actual wearing. I bought a beautiful shirt piece for my daughter to wear for an upcoming Eid. Eid happened in April of 2024, four months after I purchase the shirt piece. Upon the very first wear, the lace appliqué at both of the elbows on the shirt ripped off!! It was not a problem of correct size , my daughter is a U.S. size 2 Petite, the XS at Sana Safinaz is her correct size (something I confirmed with the sales associate at the boutique when I purchased the clothes). The problem with the shirt was that the lace appliqué on the sleeves was not properly sewn on, it was merely basted with fabric glue. The lace appliqué should not have ripped upon first wear if it was properly sewn to the sleeve.
I contacted Sana Safinaz customer service on their Instagram and WhatsApp to ask them if they could repair or replace the shirt piece with a similar item and they said, since I brought the problem to their attention AFTER 14 days of purchase there was nothing they could do for me. Really. The problem of finding a tailor to fix this mess is mine now. I had purchased the clothes during travel, how would I have realized within 14 days of purchase that the  clothes were defective since they seemed fine after purchasing, and my daughter was in America and had not gotten a chance to try on the clothes until 4 months later. I am very disappointed that Sana Safinaz does not stand by the quality of their products, and even more disappointed that they sell defective products in the first place and pass the problem on to their customers.  I won’t be shopping at their boutiques again.
